appDescription: An EV charging ledger that automatically records charging sessions, calculates charging costs from per-station unit prices, compares them with a gasoline car, and guides the driver to stations used before.

function.name: SET_CHARGING_UNIT_PRICE
function.description: Save the electricity unit price per kWh for the charging station just used, the apartment home charger, or a charging operator. Prices differ by charger power tier, so include the charger's rated power when the user mentions it.

unitPrice.description: Charging price in Korean won per kWh. Use 0 only when the user says the station just used is free of charge.

target.description: Where the price applies: this_station for the station just used, apartment for the home apartment charger, or the name of a charging operator.

chargingSpeed.description: Charger speed class the price belongs to (slow = AC, fast = DC, ultra_fast = high-power DC). Use chargerKw instead when the user says the charger power.

chargerKw.description: Rated power of the charger in kW as written on the charger, for example 7, 50, 100, 200 or 350. The price is saved to that power tier.

function.name: SETTLE_APARTMENT_CHARGING_BILL
function.description: Apply the monthly EV charging fee from the apartment maintenance bill to that month's home charging records.

amount.description: EV charging fee on the apartment maintenance bill in Korean won.

function.name: GET_CHARGING_COST_SUMMARY
function.description: Tell the total EV charging cost and number of charging sessions for a month.

function.name: GET_CHARGING_SAVINGS
function.description: Tell how much money the driver saved on charging compared with driving a gasoline or diesel car the same distance, based on recorded charging costs and odometer readings.

month.description: Month in YYYY-MM format. Omit for the total of all records.

function.name: NAVIGATE_TO_CHARGING_STATION
function.description: Start navigation to a charging station the driver has used before, chosen from the charging records: the cheapest one, the most visited one, the last one, or one matching a spoken name.

stationName.description: Part of the station name or operator when which is name, for example a branch name.

function.name: GET_EXPECTED_CHARGING_COST
function.description: Estimate the charging cost at the charging station currently set as the navigation destination or waypoint, using the navigation charging plan and the unit price known for that station.
